content.text: We need a key rotation story for the signed links before the audit. Write up what changes.

Every signed link we mint — unsubscribe, preference centre, one click resubscribe — is signed with a single key that has never been rotated. Rotation is only safe if verify() accepts the previous key for as long as the longest token can stay valid, which means the rotation window and the token expiry are the same number written in two places. Today the unsubscribe token is valid for 72 hours after we mint it, measured from generation rather than from when the recipient opened the email, so a rotation has to keep the retired key live for at least that long or every link already sitting in an inbox stops working.
Two key slots, current and previous, both accepted by verify(). Rotation script swaps them and waits out the window before dropping the old one.
